common.loadingFailed: The app could not open its local database.
common.name: Name

meal.title: Log a meal
meal.allergensHint: Suggestions are only a guess from the ingredient text. Check them before saving.
meal.aiAllergensConfirmBody: These ingredient names (text only, no photo) are sent over the internet to Anthropic to suggest which allergens they contain. Nothing is selected or saved from the answer until you select it. Anthropic bills this separately to your API account (a small amount); a Claude subscription does not cover it.
meal.aiAllergensSaved: Taken from suggestions saved on this phone; nothing was sent.
meal.aiAllergensKept: {{n}} more ingredients were asked before and are not sent again.
meal.aiAllergensRunning: Asking the model about the ingredients. You can keep entering the meal.
meal.aiAllergensHint: The AI suggests these allergens: {{list}}. They are not selected until you select them.
meal.aiAllergensNone: The AI found no allergens in these ingredients. Check the list yourself.
meal.labelConfirmTitle: Send this label photo to Anthropic?
meal.labelConfirmBody: The photo of the label is sent over the internet to Anthropic to read the ingredients. Nothing is saved from the answer until you review it, and the photo is deleted from your phone afterwards. Anthropic bills this separately to your API account (a small amount); a Claude subscription does not cover it.
meal.labelSuggested: Read from the label. Pick what to add; you can edit the list afterwards.
meal.labelTagsHint: The label lists these allergens or traces: {{list}}. They are not selected until you select them.
meal.photoConfirmBody: The photo is sent over the internet to Anthropic to guess the ingredients. Nothing is saved from the answer until you review it. Anthropic bills this separately to your API account (a small amount); a Claude subscription does not cover it.
meal.knownNamesSent: {{n}} ingredient names from your diary are sent with the photo, because "Prefer my ingredient names" is on.
meal.suggested: Suggested ingredients. Check and edit them before saving.
meal.nameConfirmBody:
This text is sent over the internet to Anthropic (no photo) to list the ingredients the dish usually contains:

“{{text}}”

Nothing is saved from the answer until you review it. Anthropic bills this separately to your API account (a small amount); a Claude subscription does not cover it.
meal.knownNamesSentName: {{n}} ingredient names from your diary are sent with the name, because "Prefer my ingredient names" is on.
meal.nameSuggested: Typical ingredients of this dish, not necessarily what you ate. Add what applies and edit the list.
meal.nameEmpty: The name is too vague to list ingredients. Nothing was suggested.
meal.estimatingName: Looking up the usual ingredients from the name. You can keep entering the meal.
meal.chooseHint: Pick an earlier meal to fill the form, or type a new one and continue. Nothing is saved until you save.
meal.reviewHint: Check the ingredients and allergen tags before saving.
meal.estimating: Estimating ingredients from the photo. You can keep entering the meal.
meal.estimateSlow: Still working, keep entering the meal.
meal.scanTitle: Point the camera at the barcode
meal.scanNotFound: This product is not in the database. Enter it by hand.
meal.scanIncomplete: The database has no ingredients for this product. Add them by hand.
meal.scanInStoreBody: This number is used by shops for their own products, so the same code can mean different products. Is the match right?
meal.scanFromDbTranslated: Filled from Open Food Facts. The ingredients are the database's Polish translation of the label, so check them against the pack.
meal.scanFromDb: Filled from Open Food Facts. Check it before saving.
meal.scanFromHistory: Filled from your diary: this code was last logged on {{date}}. The ingredients and tags are the ones you confirmed then.
meal.scanTagsHint: The database lists these allergens: {{list}}. They are not selected until you select them.

skin.title: Log skin status
skin.sizeHint: For a patch that stays in one place. Leave it empty otherwise.
skin.sizeMissing: a size of 1 to 500 mm, or leave it empty
skin.noChangeHint: Saves a new entry with the same scores as the last one for this area.
skin.prefilled: Scores start from the last entry for this area.
skin.noChangeAllNeed: These areas need a first entry: {{list}}.

data.exportHint: Creates a ZIP with data.json. Share it to Files, AirDrop or email. Anyone who opens the file can read your diary.
data.importHint: Restore or migrate from an exported ZIP. The API key is not part of an export; enter it again after migrating.
data.replaceConfirmBody: The selected data currently in the app will be replaced and cannot be recovered. Export first if you are unsure.
data.partRecords: Records (meals, check-ins, skin and nail entries, ...)
data.previewRecords: Records: {{meals}} meals, {{entries}} skin entries, {{other}} other records. Merge would add {{newMeals}} meals, {{newEntries}} skin entries and {{newOther}} other records.
data.previewSettings: Settings: {{areas}} areas, {{lists}} tags and treatments. Merge would add {{newAreas}} areas and {{newLists}} list items; existing ones keep your local values.
data.passwordHint: Encrypts the ZIP with AES-256. Use a long passphrase (at least 12 characters). A forgotten password cannot be recovered. File names stay visible, and opening the file needs a tool such as 7-Zip.
data.backupHint: Records and settings with all photos, sensitive ones included, in one ZIP. Use it to back up or to move to another phone. Anyone who opens the file can read your diary.
data.tombstoneSkipped: {{n}} entries in this file were deleted on this phone or in the file, so merge skips them.
data.tombstoneRestore: Restore the ones deleted on this phone
data.tombstoneRemoves: {{n}} entries on this phone were deleted in this file, so merge deletes them here too.

errors.invalid_score: Scores must be whole numbers from 0 to 10.
errors.invalid_size: The size must be a whole number of millimetres from 1 to 500.
errors.import_corrupt_zip: This file is not a valid ZIP.
errors.import_missing_data: The ZIP does not contain data.json.
errors.import_unsupported_version: This export was made by a newer version of the app.
errors.import_invalid_data: data.json has invalid or inconsistent content.
errors.import_unknown_area: Some entries use a skin area that is not in the app. Import the settings too, or add the area first.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.password_too_short: Use at least 12 characters for the password.
errors.import_password_required: This file is password protected. Enter its password.
errors.import_too_large: The data in this file is larger than the app accepts.
errors.wrong_area_kind: This area is the wrong kind for this entry.
errors.invalid_nail_value: Choose a stage and an extent.
errors.checkin_not_found: There is no Daily health record for that day.
errors.import_unknown_item: Some entries use a tag or treatment that is not in the app. Import the settings too, or add it first.
errors.import_unknown_meal: Some reactions point at a meal that is not in the app.
errors.reaction_before_meal: A reaction cannot start before its meal.
errors.invalid_range: The date range is not valid.
errors.no_previous_entry: There is no earlier entry for this area yet.
errors.invalid_amount: Enter an amount in whole millilitres, above zero.
errors.import_unknown_entry: Some photos belong to an entry that is not in the app.
errors.import_missing_photo: The ZIP is missing a photo that data.json refers to.
errors.photo_failed: The photo could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
errors.photo_permission_denied: Photo access was refused. You can allow it in the iPhone settings.
errors.llm_no_key: Add your Anthropic API key in Settings first.
errors.llm_invalid_key: The API key was not accepted. Check it or enter a new one.
errors.llm_rate_limited: Too many requests right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.llm_timeout: The request took too long and was stopped. Nothing was changed. Try again with less data.
errors.llm_unavailable: The service is busy or down. Try again later. Nothing was changed.
errors.llm_billing: The account has a billing problem or its spend limit was reached.
errors.llm_permission: This key is not allowed to use that model.
errors.llm_model_not_found: That model name was not found. Check the model setting.
errors.llm_bad_response: The answer could not be read. Nothing was saved.
errors.llm_failed: The request failed. Nothing was saved.
errors.analysis_too_large: That date range is too large to send. Choose a shorter range.
errors.analysis_no_data: There is nothing logged in that date range.
errors.no_ingredients: Add at least one ingredient first.
errors.summary_empty: The summary is empty. Write something or discard it.
errors.summary_mismatch: That summary was made for another period or language. Make a new one.
errors.too_many_photos: Too many photos for one run. Choose fewer.
errors.checkin_day_taken: That day already has a Daily health record. Open it instead.
errors.meal_after_reaction: A meal cannot be moved after its reaction.
errors.duplicate_area_name: An area with this name already exists.
errors.day_has_no_meals: No meals are logged for this day. Save the Daily health record anyway?
errors.notifications_denied: Notifications are turned off for this app. Allow them in the iPhone settings to get reminders.
errors.invalid_barcode: This is not a valid barcode. Check the digits.
errors.barcode_lookup_failed: The product database could not be reached. Enter the product by hand.
errors.lock_unavailable: Set a passcode or Face ID on this iPhone first.
errors.lock_failed: Could not confirm it is you. The lock was not changed.

today.title: Daily health
today.hint: Leave a score unset if you do not want to record it. Saving logs the day.
today.noYesterday: There is no Daily health record for the day before.

treatmentReaction.title: Reaction after applying
treatmentReaction.hint: Burning, itching or redness after applying. Leave it empty if you did not note it: empty is not the same as none.

more.drinkName: Drink (for example beer or coffee with milk)
more.reactionUrgent: Swelling of the face or throat, or trouble breathing, needs urgent medical care. Call emergency services. Do not wait for this app.

change.inUseNone: Nothing is marked as in use.
change.dateUnknownHint: Saved without a date. The analysis is told it was already in use.

photos.removeBody: It is deleted from this device and cannot be recovered.
photos.title: Photos
photos.formHint: Photos are saved with the entry. Tap one to drop it.
photos.someFailed: {{n}} photos could not be saved. The entry was saved.

delete.title: Delete data
delete.hint: Removes entries from this device. Areas, tags and treatments stay. This cannot be undone, so export first if you are unsure.

groups.food: Food and intake (meals, reactions, drinks, medications)
groups.skin: Skin and nails (entries, photos, treatments applied)

delete.secondBody: These entries will be removed from this phone and cannot be recovered.

exportPhotos.title: Photos in the export
exportPhotos.hint: Sensitive photos are left out unless you choose otherwise. The same choice applies to everything in the file.
exportPhotos.customHint: Tap the photos to include, one by one. Sensitive photos are included only when you pick them.

llm.title: AI settings
llm.keyHint: Your Anthropic API key is stored only in the iPhone Keychain and is never shown again. Using it sends the data you confirm to Anthropic and costs money on your account.
llm.modelsHint: Each AI action uses its own model. Haiku 5.5 is the default: fast and cheap. A larger model costs more per run.

analysis.title: AI analysis
analysis.disclaimer: AI-generated and tentative. These are possible patterns to discuss with a doctor, not a diagnosis and not medical advice.
analysis.photosHint: Photos are not sent unless you choose them. Sensitive photos are marked.
analysis.confirmIntro: This data leaves your phone and is sent over the internet to Anthropic using your API key. Anthropic bills this separately to your API account; a Claude subscription does not cover it. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
analysis.range: Days: {{from}} to {{to}} ({{days}} days, {{complete}} with a Daily health record)
analysis.lookback: Also included for context: {{n}} earlier days of illness, stress, sleep, medication and changes.
analysis.running: Analysing… this can take a few minutes. Keep the app open.
analysis.saved: Saved with the analysis. Your entries were not changed.
analysis.interrupted: The analysis was interrupted when the app was left. Nothing was saved.

report.title: Skin and health diary: report
report.disclaimer: This report is a summary of what one person recorded. It is not a diagnosis or medical advice. Scores are the person's own ratings.
report.name: Name
report.summaryEdited: edited by the person after it was written
report.aiMarkLegend: [AI] after the ingredients: they were read by an AI model from a photo or a label, or listed by it from the name of the dish (a typical recipe, not necessarily what was eaten), and the person reviewed and confirmed them before saving. [AI, edited]: the person changed them afterwards. [AI] after the allergens: the tags were suggested by an AI model and selected by the person.
report.aiTitle: AI analyses (not part of the person's records)
report.aiWarning: AI-generated and tentative. These are possible patterns written by an AI model from the diary, not findings of a doctor and not a diagnosis.
report.flaresBasis: Flares are periods in which a skin area's severity was {{n}} or higher. Their timing is only as precise as the logging.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hint: Reminders are notifications on this phone only. They never contain your entries.
reminders.nails: Weekly nail photo (only while you track nails)

text.checkInBody: Take a minute to log today.
text.nailsBody: Time to photograph your nails and log how they look.
text.backupBody: Export your diary from the Data tab and keep the file safe.

settings.sensitiveDefault: New photos of this area are sensitive
settings.photosInfo: Photos are stored in the app's private storage on this phone, never in the photo library, and EXIF data such as location is removed when they are saved. They leave the phone only in an export you share or in an AI run you confirm.
settings.photosSensitive: Sensitive photos are blurred in the app and left out of the Doctor report and AI runs unless you include them. Set an area's default in Skin and nail areas, or change a single photo.
settings.skinAreaName: New or new name of the selected skin area
settings.nailAreaName: New or new name of the selected nail
settings.favHint: Favorites come first in the suggestions. Tap one to remove it.
settings.favNone: No favorites yet. Star a meal, drink or medication when you log it.
settings.itemsHint: Scores run from 0 to 10; yes or no items record only a yes. An archived item is no longer asked, but its history stays in the report and the analysis.
settings.itemYesNo: New item is yes or no
settings.flareThresholdHint: A flare is a period in which a skin area's severity is at or above this number. It ends at the first later entry below it. Changing it recomputes the flares from the entries.
settings.loggingHint: Day start, flares, Daily health items, areas, treatments, favorites
settings.aiHint: Your API key and the model for each action

about.title: About
about.local: Everything you log stays on this phone. There is no account, no cloud sync and no analytics. Data leaves only through an export you share or an AI run you confirm.
about.ai: AI output (ingredient reads, allergen suggestions, summaries, analyses) is a tentative suggestion for you to review, and is marked as AI in exports.
about.medical: This app is a diary, not a medical device. It never gives a diagnosis or medical advice; discuss what you see with a doctor.

range.invalid: The first day is after the last day.

review.empty: Nothing to review yet. Entries you log on Today show up here.
review.noAreas: No skin or nail entries yet.
review.comparePick: Tap two photos to compare them.
review.jumpOldest: No entry on or before {{picked}}, showing the oldest day, {{shown}}.
review.timelineEmpty: Nothing logged for this area yet.
review.incompleteHint: Days with entries but no Daily health record.
review.noIncomplete: Every day with entries has a Daily health record.
review.healthEmpty: Nothing to chart yet. Save Daily health records with a score first.

day.dayStartHint: A day runs from this hour to the same hour the next day, so a drink at 00:30 can belong to the evening before. Set it once: changing it regroups the whole diary, while the time of each entry stays as it was.

log.alsoNothing: This cannot be undone here; restore it from a backup.

cards.noExport: No export yet. The diary exists only on this phone.
cards.notLogged: This day has no Daily health record yet.
cards.firstRun: Your diary is empty. Start with a meal, or see where each kind of entry goes.

edit.title: Edit entry
edit.name: a name
edit.unavailable: This entry can no longer be edited.

doctor.counts: {{entries}} entries and {{photos}} photos in this period.
doctor.sensitiveHint: Off by default. Sensitive photos leave the phone only when you turn this on.
doctor.empty: Nothing to export in this period.
doctor.hint: A PDF report with the raw data, for a doctor. Records only; use Data and backup for a full backup.
doctor.summaryHint: Optional: a short AI-written narrative of this period opens the report. You review and can edit it before it goes in. No photos are sent.
doctor.summaryConfirmTitle: Send this to Anthropic to write a summary?
doctor.summaryFailed: Nothing was saved. You can try again.
doctor.summaryReview: Review the summary. Edit it as you like; nothing is saved until you use it.
doctor.summaryIncluded: The report opens with this summary (AI-generated, reviewed by you):

sugg.knownNamesHint: Off by default. A photo estimate then also sends the ingredient names you have already used (names only, not entries or photos), so the model uses your spelling. The confirmation says how many.
sugg.saveOnTapHint: A tap on a drink or medication suggestion saves it at once. Meals never save on tap.
sugg.hint: Suggestions are worked out on this phone from your own entries. Nothing is sent anywhere.

lock.switch: Lock with Face ID or passcode
lock.hint: Locks the app when it starts and after a minute in the background. Your diary stays on this phone either way. In Expo Go the system asks for the passcode, because Face ID needs a standalone build.

itemDescriptions.item-wellbeing: How well you felt overall today. 0 is very poor, 10 is very good.
itemDescriptions.item-stress: How stressed you felt today. 0 is not at all, 10 is extreme.
itemDescriptions.item-sleep: How well you slept last night. 0 is very poor, 10 is very good.
itemDescriptions.item-abdominal-pain: Stomach or belly pain today. 0 is none, 10 is the worst imaginable.
itemDescriptions.item-bloating: A swollen or tight belly today.
itemDescriptions.tag-illness-or-infection: A cold, flu or other infection today.
itemDescriptions.tag-heavy-sweating: Sport or heat made you sweat a lot.
itemDescriptions.tag-sauna-or-pool: You were in a sauna or a swimming pool.
itemDescriptions.tag-sun-exposure: A lot of time in strong sun.
itemDescriptions.tag-hot-shower: A hot or long shower or bath today.
itemDescriptions.tag-intimate-friction: Tight clothing, cycling or other friction in the intimate area today.
itemDescriptions.cat-product: Anything that touches the skin or its surroundings: cosmetics, detergents, clothing, jewelry. Log it once when it starts and once when it stops.
itemDescriptions.cat-diet: A way of eating you started or stopped, for example gluten-free or no dairy. It does not replace logging meals.

regular.switchHint: Adds it to the quick sheet and lets you set reminders (Settings, Logging, Regular items).
regular.hideNameHint: A reminder then says only "Time for your medication" or "Time for your treatment". It never shows a dose or a note.
regular.stopBody: Its reminders end and it leaves the quick sheet. Entries already logged stay.
regular.denied: Notifications are turned off for this app, so reminders cannot be shown.

items.regularCream: A treatment I use every day
